title: record page: a failed comments or attachments read (500) shows as 「暂无评论」 and an empty attachment count; only a refusal is flagged, so a server error is silent
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate ①: a product defect, measured on staging by cloud#3485 (every filtered `sys_comment` / `sys_attachment` read on hosted environments answers 500 `DATABASE_ERROR`; card filed by the maintainer's session 2026-11-02). Cloud is fixing its server half. This card is the Console half (cloud#3485 acceptance 3).

## What happens

On a record page, when the comments read or the attachments read fails with a server error, the discussion panel shows 「暂无评论」 and the attachments tab shows an empty count. The user sees no sign of the failure; it is visible only in developer tools. On staging this has hidden a 500 on every hosted environment since at least 2026-10-29, so comments and attachments users wrote looked lost.

## Cause (objectstack main)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`: the feed reads end in `.catch((err) => { recordRefusal('comments', isRefusedFeedRead(err)); })` (around lines 3098 and 3175). Only a refusal is recorded (`feedRefusalByRecord`, around 2899 and 2970), and any other failure falls through to the empty state. The attachments read has the same shape.

## Ask

- Tell a failed read apart from an empty one: a server error (5xx, network) shows a load-failure state with a retry, not the empty state. Refusals keep today's handling.
- The same for the attachments tab and its count.
- Tests: a 500 on each read renders the failure state; an empty 200 still renders 「暂无评论」.

## Business reason

Comments and attachments sit on every business record. A silent empty state makes data look lost and hides outages from users and from support.

## Reader

The Console record-page owner, through objectstack triage. No cloud change is needed for this half.

## Dedup

Searched open objectstack issues for "暂无评论 load failure", "feed read error empty state" and "RecordDetailView refusal 500": none open.
